headline: RBI delegates FEMA compounding for ODI, borrowing/lending and guarantees to Regional Offices
summary_points: Powers to compound contraventions on Overseas Investment, Borrowing/Lending and Guarantees are delegated to select RBI Regional Offices, not only Central Office.
ODI compounding applications go to the Regional Office based on the UIN prefix of the foreign entity, JV or WOS.
Borrowing, lending and guarantee cases go to the Regional Office with jurisdiction over the registered office or domicile of the applicant.
Cases with no UIN, or involving multiple categories under different rules, go to CEFA, Foreign Exchange Department, Central Office, Mumbai.

rows: ODI: UIN prefix BL, BY or PJ
ODI: UIN prefix BN, CA, GA or GH
ODI: UIN prefix CG, JM, JR, KA, ND, PT or WR
ODI: UIN prefix KO or MA
No UIN, or multiple categories; Borrowing/Lending/Guarantees
CEFA, Central Office (no UIN or multiple); jurisdictional Regional Office (borrowing/lending/guarantees)

who_is_affected: AD Category-I banks, other Authorised Persons and Indian companies or entities seeking to compound FEMA contraventions on overseas investment, borrowing, lending or guarantees.
action_required: Route compounding applications to the correct Regional Office or CEFA as per the circular, and bring its contents to the notice of constituents.

social.linkedin:
RBI has delegated powers to compound certain FEMA contraventions to its Regional Offices.

Vide A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 28/2026-27 dated October 23, 2026, applications relating to Overseas Investment, Borrowing and Lending, and Guarantees, which were earlier received at the Central Office, can now be filed at select Regional Offices.

Key points:
- Overseas Investment: the Regional Office is determined by the UIN prefix of the foreign entity, JV or WOS (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Kolkata, New Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai).
- Borrowing, Lending and Guarantees: apply to the Regional Office with jurisdiction over the registered office or domicile of the applicant.
- No UIN allotted, or multiple categories of contraventions under different rules: apply to CEFA at the Central Office, Mumbai.

The Master Directions on Compounding of Contraventions under FEMA will be updated accordingly.

Companies and AD banks should review pending and planned compounding matters and file at the right office.

Please verify the details with the official RBI circular before acting.
